correctness.rationale: Rebuilt Cervone 1133 triangulation directly from the 16 listed faces: (V,E,F)=(8,24,16), valence multiset (4,5,6,6,6,7,7,7). Contracting the seven A-star edges leaves 17 generators; direct independent exact rational rank of all sixteen face relations is 16, all seventeen maximal 16x16 minors have gcd 2, so H1≅Z⊕Z/2; the mod2 matrix rank is 15. Enumerating all 3-cliques gives 36, 16 filled and 20 empty. Primitive cofactor null vector evaluates free coordinate zero on 8 empties and ±1 on 12; independent canonical mod2 quotient reduction puts 8,6,6 empties into the three nonzero classes. The precise labeled partition reproduces the eight t cycles ABC,ABG,ADE,ADG,BCF,BCH,CEF,DEF, the six ±g cycles ABE,ABF,ACD,ACF,AFH,BDF and six ±(g+t) cycles ACE,BCD,BDE,BEG,CDG,CEG. Therefore every empty triangle is essential and these exhaust three-edge simple-cycle nonzero unoriented integral types with |free|≤1. No inference about longer cycles or other five eight-vertex types.
